change_summary: Added launcher-attested Codex-Claude mailbox debate, durable transcript and attachment bindings, D0-D3 promotion requests, and create/claim/self-registration admission gates without changing trading behavior.
component: README.md, docs/agent_mailbox.md, docs/alpha_search_architecture.md, docs/agent_experiment_protocol.md, docs/research_digest_pipeline.md, scripts/agent_mailbox.py, scripts/alpha_debate.py, scripts/alpha_search.py, scripts/create_experiment_ticket.py, scripts/claim_experiment.py, scripts/experiment_registry.py, quant/alpha_search_contract.py, quant/test_agent_mailbox.py, quant/test_alpha_debate.py, quant/test_alpha_search_cli.py, quant/test_create_experiment_ticket.py, quant/test_experiment_registry.py, data/alpha_search
hypothesis: Alpha discovery can bypass independent challenge because mailbox identities are self-declared and experiment reservation or claim does not require a D0-D3 panel-bound opposite-runtime debate. Binding launcher-attested Codex-versus-Claude debate evidence and a verified promotion request into alpha ticket creation and claim should prevent same-model self-review and direct-ticket bypasses without changing trading logic.
next_retry_requires: a demonstrable post-cutoff admission bypass not covered by the current create, claim, audit, or self-registration gates
or a stronger provider-attestation mechanism than the explicitly documented local launcher receipt
notes: Accepted as measurement repair: 186 focused tests passed; same-runtime review, missing or tampered artifacts, unresolved claims, panel/proposal mismatch, force bypass, and direct self-registration fail closed. Measurement-repair tickets remain unaffected. A real Claude debate was not claimed because cross-provider context sharing still requires explicit user authorization.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not add another sender-name convention, prose-only debate rule, or second unbound review checklist; those leave the same bypass intact.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only with a reproducible post-cutoff bypass, a new runtime/provider trust primitive, or a changed experiment lifecycle that is not covered by the shared promotion validator.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The largest hidden gap was not candidate generation itself but that the prior mailbox sender name and experiment lifecycle were not identity- or evidence-bound; enforcing the boundary required both live mailbox verification at promotion build time and a portable frozen proof for later claim and audit.

reopen_condition: Reopen only with a reproducible post-cutoff alpha admission bypass, a stronger provider-attestation primitive than the documented local launcher receipt, or a newly introduced experiment lifecycle path outside the shared promotion validator.
